source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi,

[FREELANCER_NAME_002] you for sharing [FREELANCER_NAME_006] latest version. It is now much closer to what I had in mind, and I’m satisfied with [FREELANCER_NAME_006] overall design direction. I don’t believe another redesign is necessary—only a final tidy-up before approval.

Could you please complete these last amendments:

1. Assessment date placeholder

On page one, [FREELANCER_NAME_006] current report reads:

"Assessment Date: Assessment Date.”

Please replace it with either:
“Assessment Date: \[Assessment Date\]”

or use an editable date field that allows me to change it for every customer.

2. Correct a typo

[FREELANCER_NAME_006] text on page 2 currently reads:
“Owners often overrate gated drivers.”

Please update it to:
“Owners often overrate gated driveways.”

3. Revise an awkward sentence

On page 2, [FREELANCER_NAME_006] current sentence is:

“Assessment note: Storage is helping presentations slightly...”

Please replace it with:

“Assessment note: Storage slightly improves [FREELANCER_NAME_006] vehicle’s security presentation, but not enough to offset [FREELANCER_NAME_006] wider weaknesses in [FREELANCER_NAME_006] setup.”

4. Restore [FREELANCER_NAME_006] page 4 footer

Pages 1, 2 and 3 use [FREELANCER_NAME_006] same footer, but page 4 appears to be missing it due to [FREELANCER_NAME_006] distribution warning section.

Please reinstate [FREELANCER_NAME_006] standard footer on page 4 so [FREELANCER_NAME_006] entire report has a consistent footer.

5. Refine [FREELANCER_NAME_006] final distribution warning section

I like having [FREELANCER_NAME_006] distribution warning, although it remains slightly too prominent at [FREELANCER_NAME_006] bottom of page 4. Please reduce or refine it a little so it stays clear and professional without dominating [FREELANCER_NAME_006] page or conflicting with [FREELANCER_NAME_006] footer.

After these updates are completed, I believe [FREELANCER_NAME_006] report will be ready for sign-off.

Thanks

value_updates.final_page_warning_coexistence: The standard footer must remain present on page 4 and must not conflict with the distribution warning.
